description: We’re a 5-person Charlotte team building a Space Mission Design Game where real NASA data decides if your mission succeeds. We have 3 coders, 1 designers/video creator, 2 presenters, plus a clear plan and roles. Join us to build a real, playable game with NASA data. We have 1 spot open and want someone into data, math, or physics to turn NASA numbers like distance, gravity, and fuel into game rules. Space science or sound design is a plus!
